source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 19 (PDF 38-58), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 19 (Basics of Organic Chemistry) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 How does IUPAC define organic chemistry? Name two carbon compounds that are excluded from it.
(IUPAC organic chemistry ki kya definition deta hai? Is se bahar rakhe gaye do carbon compounds ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
IUPAC: organic chemistry un compounds ka mutaala hai jin mein carbon khud se, hydrogen ya doosre elements se juda ho, siwaye kuch inorganic compounds ke.
Bahar rakhe gaye: carbonates, cyanides (jaise KCN), CO₂, CO.

book_ref.quote: the study of compounds containing carbon, where carbon is bonded to itself, hydrogen, or other elements

blocks.prompt:
2 What is catenation? Why is it important in organic chemistry?
(Catenation kya hai? Organic chemistry mein yeh kyun aham hai?)
blocks.explanation: Catenation (Latin catena = zanjeer) aik hi element ke atoms ka aapas mein judne ki salahiyat hai. Carbon mazboot C–C covalent bonds se lambi chains aur rings banata hai; isi liye organic compounds pecheeda, bari structures wale aur bohat mukhtalif hain.

book_ref.quote: The ability of self-linkage between the atoms of the same element is known as catenation

blocks.prompt:
3 How does the tetravalency of carbon lead to a large variety of compounds?
(Carbon ki tetravalency (chaar valency) bohat se compounds ka sabab kaise banti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Carbon tetravalent hai, is liye har carbon chaar atoms se jur sakta hai aur carbon atoms bohat tareeqon (seedhi chain, shaakhein, rings) se jur sakte hain. Maslan chaar carbon atoms ki chaar mukhtalif tarteebein hain, jis se bohat se compounds bante hain.

book_ref.quote: Tetravalent nature of carbon enables it to have much more different ways of arrangements

blocks.prompt:
4 Give any three properties by which organic compounds can be distinguished from inorganic compounds.
(Woh teen properties likhein jin se organic compounds ko inorganic compounds se alag pehchana ja sakta hai.)
blocks.explanation: Organic compounds ke aam tor par (i) melting aur boiling points kam, (ii) densities kam, (iii) paani mein solubility kam hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Organic compounds can be easily distinguished from inorganic compounds by their unique properties

blocks.text: 19.2 Hydrocarbons (Compounds of Carbon and Hydrogen Only)

blocks.prompt:
5 What are hydrocarbons? On what basis are they classified?
(Hydrocarbons kya hain? Inhein kis bunyad par baanta jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hydrocarbons woh compounds hain jin mein sirf carbon aur hydrogen hon. Carbon skeleton (dhaancha) ki bunyad par yeh open chain (acyclic ya aliphatic) aur closed chain (cyclic) mein bante hain.

book_ref.quote: Compounds containing carbon and hydrogen only in their molecules are called hydrocarbons

blocks.prompt:
6 Why are open chain hydrocarbons called aliphatic hydrocarbons?
(Open chain hydrocarbons ko aliphatic kyun kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: 'Aliphatic' Greek lafz aleiphatos se hai jis ka matlab charbi (fat) hai. Fats open chain structure rakhte hain, is liye open chain carbon atoms wale hydrocarbons aliphatic kehlate hain.

book_ref.quote: aleiphatos is a Greek word meaning fat

blocks.prompt:
7 How are aliphatic hydrocarbons subdivided? Give the families.
(Aliphatic hydrocarbons ki mazeed taqseem kaise hoti hai? Families batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Aliphatic hydrocarbons saturated (alkanes) aur unsaturated (alkenes aur alkynes) mein bante hain.

book_ref.quote: These can be further subdivided into saturated hydrocarbons (alkanes)

blocks.prompt:
8 Differentiate between alicyclic and aromatic hydrocarbons.
(Alicyclic aur aromatic hydrocarbons mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono cyclic (closed chain) hydrocarbons hain:

book_ref.quote: which behave like aliphatic hydrocarbons, are called alicyclic hydrocarbons

rows: Benzene ring ya us jaisi structure

blocks.prompt:
9 Differentiate between acyclic and cyclic hydrocarbons.
(Acyclic aur cyclic hydrocarbons mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Carbon skeleton ki bunyad par:

book_ref.quote: Hydrocarbons possessing open chain of carbon atoms are called open chain or acyclic hydrocarbons

rows: Carbon atoms khuli chain banate hain
Alicyclic aur aromatic mein bante hain

blocks.prompt:
10 What is a functional group? Give two examples.
(Functional group kya hai? Do misaalein dein.)
blocks.explanation:
Woh atom, atoms ka group ya double/triple bond ki maujoodgi jo organic compound ki khaas properties tay kare, functional group kehlata hai.
Misaalein: –OH (alcohols), –COOH (carboxylic acids).

book_ref.quote: which determines the characteristic properties of an organic compound is called functional group

blocks.prompt:
11 Methanol is a liquid but methane is a gas at room temperature. Give reason.
(Room temperature par methanol liquid magar methane gas hai. Wajah batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Methanol mein hydroxyl functional group (–OH) hai jo molecules ke darmiyan hydrogen bonds banata hai; methane mein koi functional group nahi. Is liye methanol ke m.p aur b.p zyada hain aur woh liquid hai.

book_ref.quote: Methanol and ethanol are liquids while methane and ethane are gases

blocks.prompt:
12 Why are glucose and sucrose soluble in water?
(Glucose aur sucrose paani mein kyun hal hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Glucose aur sucrose (chhote alcohols aur carboxylic acids ki tarah) polar functional groups rakhte hain, is liye polar solvent paani mein hal hote hain.

book_ref.quote: are soluble in polar solvents like water due to their polar functional groups

blocks.prompt:
13 Name the two factors of a functional group which dictate the type of an organic compound.
(Functional group ke woh do factors batayein jo organic compound ki qisam tay karte hain.)
blocks.explanation: (i) Bond ki polarity. (ii) Bond order, yani functional group mein bonds ki tadaad.

book_ref.quote: The types of organic compounds are dictated by the following factors

blocks.prompt:
14 Why was a systematic (IUPAC) nomenclature of organic compounds needed?
(Organic compounds ke systematic (IUPAC) naamon ki zaroorat kyun pesh aayi?)
blocks.explanation: Qudrat mein millions organic compounds hain aur har saal hazaron naye bante hain, is liye unhein structure ke mutabiq naam dena zaroori tha. IUPAC ne qawaid banaye; naam parent hydrocarbon par mabni hai.

book_ref.quote: A set of rules was thus formulated by IUPAC

blocks.prompt:
15 What does the stem or root of an IUPAC name show? How is the chain numbered?
(IUPAC naam ka stem ya root kya batata hai? Chain ko number kaise diya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Stem sab se lambi musalsal carbon chain batata hai jis mein functional group wala carbon shamil ho. Functional group wale carbon ko sab se chhota number diya jata hai. Ring ho to naam 'cyclo' se shuru hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Lowest possible number is given to the carbon bearing the functional group

blocks.prompt:
16 Differentiate between primary suffix and secondary suffix.
(Primary suffix aur secondary suffix mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: IUPAC naam ke do qisam ke suffixes:

book_ref.quote: Primary suffix, also called suffix of stem or root

rows: Stem ya root ka suffix bhi kehte hain
Key functional group ka suffix bhi kehte hain
Batata hai ke parent chain saturated hai ya unsaturated
Compound ka family naam batata hai

blocks.prompt:
17 What is a prefix in an IUPAC name? What happens if it is absent?
(IUPAC naam mein prefix kya hai? Agar prefix na ho to kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Prefix side chain (alkyl group) ya substituent (jaise halo, nitro) ka naam us carbon ke number ke saath batata hai jis se woh juda ho. Prefix na ho to naam sirf root aur suffix par mushtamil hota hai.

book_ref.quote: It gives the name of the side chain (alkyl group) or any substituent

blocks.prompt:
18 Split the name 4-chlorobutanal into prefix, stem, primary suffix and secondary suffix.
(Naam 4-chlorobutanal ko prefix, stem, primary suffix aur secondary suffix mein taqseem karein.)
blocks.explanation: Prefix: 4-chloro (carbon 4 par Cl); stem: but (chaar carbon); primary suffix: an (saturated chain); secondary suffix: al (aldehyde family).

book_ref.quote: 4-chlorobutanal and 3-methylbut-2-en-1-ol

blocks.prompt:
19 Give the correct IUPAC name of CH₃–CH(CH₃)–CH₂–CH₂–I and state the rule used.
(CH₃–CH(CH₃)–CH₂–CH₂–I ka darust IUPAC naam likhein aur istemal hone wala qaida batayein.)
blocks.explanation: 1-iodo-3-methylbutane. Chaar carbon ki chain ko iodine wale sire se number diya jata hai aur prefixes alphabetical tarteeb mein likhe jaate hain (iodo pehle, methyl baad mein).

book_ref.quote: The substituent prefixes are written in alphabetical order

blocks.prompt:
20 Give the IUPAC names of CH₃–OH and CH₃–CH₂–CH₂–OH. To which class do they belong?
(CH₃–OH aur CH₃–CH₂–CH₂–OH ke IUPAC naam likhein. Yeh kis class se hain?)
blocks.explanation: CH₃–OH: methanol; CH₃–CH₂–CH₂–OH: propan-1-ol. Dono alcohols (alkanols) hain, general formula CₙH₂ₙ₊₂O, functional group –OH.

book_ref.quote: The IUPAC name is alkanol.

blocks.prompt:
21 Write the condensed formula of 3-methylbutanal and give the class name of aldehydes.
(3-methylbutanal ka condensed formula likhein aur aldehydes ka class naam batayein.)
blocks.explanation: 3-methylbutanal: CH₃–CH(CH₃)–CH₂–CHO (carbon 4 CH₃ hai). Aldehydes ka naam alkanal hai (CₙH₂ₙO, group –CHO).

book_ref.quote: CH₃–CH(CH₃)–CH₂–C(=O)–H (3-methylbutanal)

blocks.prompt:
22 Aldehydes and ketones have the same general formula. Show this with a three-carbon example of each.
(Aldehydes aur ketones ka general formula aik hai. Teen carbon ki aik aik misaal se dikhayein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono ka general formula CₙH₂ₙO hai. n = 3 par: propanal CH₃CH₂CHO aur propanone CH₃COCH₃ dono C₃H₆O hain; aldehyde ka –CHO chain ke sire par aur ketone ka C=O chain ke andar hai.

book_ref.quote: The IUPAC name is alkanone

blocks.prompt:
23 Give the IUPAC names of HCOOH and CH₃–CH₂–CH(CH₃)–COOH.
(HCOOH aur CH₃–CH₂–CH(CH₃)–COOH ke IUPAC naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: HCOOH: methanoic acid. CH₃–CH₂–CH(CH₃)–COOH: 2-methylbutanoic acid (COOH ka carbon C-1; methyl C-2 par). Class naam: alkanoic acid.

book_ref.quote: The IUPAC name is alkanoic acid

blocks.prompt:
24 Name CH₃–CH(CH₃)–C(=O)–NH₂ and CH₃–CH₂–CH₂–C(=O)–NH–CH₃.
(CH₃–CH(CH₃)–C(=O)–NH₂ aur CH₃–CH₂–CH₂–C(=O)–NH–CH₃ ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: CH₃–CH(CH₃)–CONH₂: 2-methylpropanamide. CH₃CH₂CH₂–CO–NH–CH₃: N-methylbutanamide (methyl nitrogen par). Class naam: alkanamide.

book_ref.quote: The IUPAC name is alkanamide

blocks.prompt:
25 Give the class name and functional group of acid halides with one example.
(Acid halides ka class naam aur functional group aik misaal ke saath likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Acid halides (CₙH₂ₙ₋₁OX), functional group –C(=O)–X, ka naam alkanoyl halide hai, jaise CH₃COCl ethanoyl chloride.

book_ref.quote: The IUPAC name is alkanoyl halides

blocks.prompt:
26 Name the esters CH₃–C(=O)–O–CH₃ and CH₃–CH₂–C(=O)–O–CH₂–CH₂–CH₃.
(Esters CH₃–C(=O)–O–CH₃ aur CH₃–CH₂–C(=O)–O–CH₂–CH₂–CH₃ ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Esters alkyl alkanoates hain (pehle O par alkyl, phir acid wala hissa):
CH₃COOCH₃: methyl ethanoate; CH₃CH₂COOCH₂CH₂CH₃: propyl propanoate.

book_ref.quote: The IUPAC name is alkyl alkanoate

blocks.prompt:
27 What is the functional group of acid anhydrides? Name CH₃–C(=O)–O–C(=O)–CH₂–CH₃.
(Acid anhydrides ka functional group kya hai? CH₃–C(=O)–O–C(=O)–CH₂–CH₃ ka naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Functional group: –C(=O)–O–C(=O)–; class naam alkanoic anhydride. CH₃CO–O–COCH₂CH₃ ethanoic propanoic anhydride hai.

book_ref.quote: The IUPAC name is alkanoic anhydride

blocks.prompt:
28 Give the IUPAC names of CH₃–O–CH₃ and CH₃–CH₂–O–CH₂–CH₃.
(CH₃–O–CH₃ aur CH₃–CH₂–O–CH₂–CH₃ ke IUPAC naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Ethers alkoxyalkanes hain: CH₃–O–CH₃ methoxymethane; CH₃CH₂–O–CH₂CH₃ ethoxyethane.

book_ref.quote: The IUPAC name is alkoxyalkane.

blocks.prompt:
29 Name the three types of amines with their IUPAC class names.
(Amines ki teen qismein un ke IUPAC class naamon ke saath likhein.)
blocks.explanation: (i) Primary amines (–C–NH₂): alkanamine, jaise ethanamine. (ii) Secondary amines (–C–NH–R): N-alkylalkanamine, jaise N-methylpropan-2-amine. (iii) Tertiary amines (–C–N(R)–R): N,N-dialkylalkanamine ya N-alkyl-N-alkylalkanamine, jaise N,N-dimethylpropan-1-amine.

book_ref.quote: There are three types of amines

blocks.prompt:
30 Why is N-methylpropan-1-amine written CH₃–CH₂–CH₂–NH–CH₃ and not with NH₂?
(N-methylpropan-1-amine ko CH₃–CH₂–CH₂–NH–CH₃ kyun likha jata hai, NH₂ ke saath kyun nahi?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh secondary amine hai: nitrogen do carbon groups se juda hai aur us par aik hydrogen hai. NH₂ ho to nitrogen ke chaar bonds ho jayenge, jo is neutral amine mein mumkin nahi.

book_ref.quote: CH₃–CH₂–CH₂–NH–CH₃ (N-methylpropan-1-amine)

blocks.prompt:
31 Give the IUPAC names of CH₃–CN and CH₃–CH(CH₃)–CN.
(CH₃–CN aur CH₃–CH(CH₃)–CN ke IUPAC naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Alkyl cyanides alkanenitriles hain (CN ka carbon chain mein gina jata hai): CH₃CN ethanenitrile; CH₃CH(CH₃)CN 2-methylpropanenitrile.

book_ref.quote: CH₃–CH(CH₃)–CN (2-methylpropanenitrile)

blocks.prompt:
32 Write the general formula of nitroalkanes and name CH₃–NO₂ and CH₃–CH(NO₂)–CH₃.
(Nitroalkanes ka general formula likhein aur CH₃–NO₂ aur CH₃–CH(NO₂)–CH₃ ke naam batayein.)
blocks.explanation: General formula CₙH₂ₙ₊₁NO₂ (group –C–NO₂). CH₃NO₂: nitromethane; CH₃CH(NO₂)CH₃: 2-nitropropane.

book_ref.quote: The IUPAC name is nitroalkane

blocks.prompt:
33 Differentiate between molecular formula and empirical formula.
(Molecular formula aur empirical formula mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Muqabla:

book_ref.quote: represents the smallest whole number ratio of atoms of each element

rows: Molecule mein har element ke atoms ki asal tadaad
Har element ke atoms ki sab se chhoti poori nisbat

blocks.prompt:
34 Why can two different compounds have the same molecular formula? Give an example.
(Do mukhtalif compounds ka molecular formula aik kyun ho sakta hai? Misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Molecular formula atoms ke judne ki tarteeb aur functional group ki nauiyat nahi batata. Maslan ethanol (CH₃CH₂OH) aur methoxymethane (CH₃OCH₃) dono C₂H₆O hain.

book_ref.quote: molecular formula gives no information about the sequence in which atoms are linked together

blocks.prompt:
35 Find the empirical formulae of hexane (C₆H₁₄) and ethyl ethanoate (C₄H₈O₂).
(Hexane (C₆H₁₄) aur ethyl ethanoate (C₄H₈O₂) ke empirical formulae nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Mushtarak factor se taqseem: C₆H₁₄ ÷ 2 = C₃H₇; C₄H₈O₂ ÷ 2 = C₂H₄O.

book_ref.quote: empirical formula of butane (C₄H₁₀) is C₂H₅

blocks.prompt:
36 What is a structural formula? Name its three types.
(Structural formula kya hai? Is ki teen qismein batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Structural formula na sirf har qisam ke atoms ki tadaad balke un ke judne ki tarteeb bhi batata hai. Qismein: (a) displayed (graphical), (b) condensed (linear), (c) skeletal (bond-line) formula.

book_ref.quote: not only shows the number of each kind of atom in the molecule but also the sequence

blocks.prompt:
37 Define displayed formula. Why is it often replaced by a condensed formula?
(Displayed formula ki definition likhein. Ise aksar condensed formula se kyun badla jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Displayed formula: woh formula jo atoms ke darmiyan tamam bonds, bonds ki qisam aur functional groups ki jagah dikhaye. Yeh bohat jagah leta hai, is liye ise aik line ke condensed (linear) formula mein likhte hain.

book_ref.quote: which shows all the bonds between different atoms including the type of bonds

blocks.prompt:
38 Write the condensed formulae of butane, ethanol and ethanoic acid.
(Butane, ethanol aur ethanoic acid ke condensed formulae likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Butane: CH₃(CH₂)₂CH₃; ethanol: CH₃CH₂OH; ethanoic acid: CH₃COOH. (Single bonds chhor diye jaate hain; beech ke methylene groups bracket mein.)

book_ref.quote: single covalent bonds are omitted, however, branches, functional groups

blocks.prompt:
39 Differentiate between condensed formula and skeletal formula.
(Condensed formula aur skeletal formula mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Muqabla:

book_ref.quote: Skeletal formula is the simplified version of displayed formula

rows: Displayed formula ki aik line wali shakal
Single bonds chhor diye; C aur H ke symbols likhe jaate hain
C aur H ke symbols aur C–H bonds hata diye jaate hain
Shaakhein, functional groups, multiple bonds bracket mein
C–C bonds zaaviye par milti lines; multiple bonds aur functional groups dikhaye jaate hain
Jaise butane teen lines ka zig-zag

blocks.prompt:
40 Write the steps to find the molecular formula of a compound from its skeletal formula.
(Skeletal formula se compound ka molecular formula nikalne ke qadam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: (i) C atoms aur dikhaye gaye heteroatoms ginein. (ii) Har line bond aur har jor carbon hai; har line ke sire par aik C ginein jab tak wahan koi aur atom na likha ho (double lines double bonds). (iii) Har carbon ke chaar bond (octet) poore karne ke liye H atoms jorein.

book_ref.quote: Count one C atom at the end of each line unless another atom is shown there

blocks.prompt:
41 A skeletal formula is a hexagon of single lines with one double line. Deduce its molecular and empirical formulae.
(Aik skeletal formula single lines ka hexagon hai jis mein aik double line hai. Is ka molecular aur empirical formula nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: 6 jor = 6 C. Double bond wale 2 carbons ko 1-1 H; baqi 4 ko 2-2 H: H = 2 + 8 = 10. Molecular formula C₆H₁₀; nisbat 6 : 10 = 3 : 5, empirical formula C₃H₅.

book_ref.quote: Count the number of H atoms necessary to complete the octet of each C atom

blocks.prompt:
42 Why are the empirical and molecular formulae of ethanamide the same?
(Ethanamide ka empirical aur molecular formula aik hi kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ethanamide (structural formula CH₃CONH₂) ka molecular formula C₂H₅NO hai. Nisbat C : H : N : O = 2 : 5 : 1 : 1 chhoti nahi ho sakti, is liye empirical formula bhi C₂H₅NO hai.

book_ref.quote: Its empirical formula is C₂H₅NO, the same as its molecular formula

blocks.prompt:
43 What are free radicals? Why are they highly reactive?
(Free radicals kya hain? Yeh bohat reactive kyun hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Unpaired electrons wale atoms ya groups free radicals hain; yeh nonpolar bond ki homolysis se bante hain, jaise Cl–Cl → 2Cl•. Yeh bohat reactive intermediates hain kyun ke un ke unpaired electrons jora banana chahte hain.

book_ref.quote: These atoms or groups of atoms with unpaired electrons are called free radicals

blocks.prompt:
44 Differentiate between a carbocation and a carbanion.
(Carbocation aur carbanion mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Muqabla:

book_ref.quote: A species which contains a carbon atom with a positive charge is known as carbocation

rows: Jab carbon zyada electronegative atom (O, N, Cl) se juda ho
Jab carbon kam electronegative metal (Li, Mg, Cd) se juda ho

blocks.prompt:
45 Show the formation of a carbocation from (CH₃)₃C–Cl. Why does chlorine take the shared pair?
((CH₃)₃C–Cl se carbocation ka banna dikhayein. Chlorine shared pair kyun le leta hai?)
blocks.explanation: (CH₃)₃C–Cl → (CH₃)₃C⁺ + Cl⁻ (heterolysis). Chlorine carbon se zyada electronegative hai, is liye dono shared electrons rakh kar Cl⁻ banta hai aur carbon positive reh jata hai.

book_ref.quote: phosphorus (electronegativity 2.2) is less electronegative than carbon (2.5)

blocks.prompt:
46 Define reagent and substrate.
(Reagent aur substrate ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Do reactants ka reaction aik species ka doosri par hamla samjha jata hai. Hamla karne wali species reagent aur jis par hamla ho woh substrate hai.

book_ref.quote: the attacking species is called reagent and the species which is undergoing attack is called the substrate

blocks.prompt:
47 Classify as electrophile or nucleophile: BF₃, CN⁻, H⁺, H₂O, CH₃⁺, NH₃.
(Electrophile ya nucleophile mein taqseem karein: BF₃, CN⁻, H⁺, H₂O, CH₃⁺, NH₃.)
blocks.explanation:
Electrophiles (electron pair lete hain): BF₃, H⁺, CH₃⁺.
Nucleophiles (electron pair dete hain): CN⁻, H₂O, NH₃.

book_ref.quote: e.g. CH₃⁻, Br⁻, OH⁻, CN⁻, NH₃, H₂O, ROH etc

blocks.prompt:
48 Show that polar molecules can have both electrophilic and nucleophilic centres, using CH₃–OH and CH₃–Li.
(CH₃–OH aur CH₃–Li ki madad se dikhayein ke polar molecules mein electrophilic aur nucleophilic dono markaz ho sakte hain.)
blocks.explanation: Polar molecules par partial charges hote hain. CH₃(δ+)–OH(δ–) mein carbon electrophilic aur OH nucleophilic hai. CH₃(δ–)–Li(δ+) mein carbon nucleophilic aur Li electrophilic hai, kyun ke Li carbon se kam electronegative hai.

book_ref.quote: The terms electrophilic and nucleophilic do not apply only to ions

blocks.prompt:
49 Differentiate between substitution and addition reactions with one example each.
(Substitution aur addition reactions mein farq aik aik misaal ke saath likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Muqabla:

book_ref.quote: an atom or group of atoms in one molecule is replaced by another atom or group of atoms

rows: Aik molecule ka atom ya group doosre se badal jata hai

blocks.prompt:
50 Write the equation for the addition of HBr to propene and name the main product.
(Propene par HBr ke addition ki equation likhein aur bare product ka naam batayein.)
blocks.explanation: CH₃–CH=CH₂ + HBr → CH₃–CHBr–CH₃. Markovnikov's rule se bara product 2-bromopropane hai.

book_ref.quote: the main product of propene with HBr is 2-bromopropane

blocks.prompt:
51 Why is elimination regarded as the reverse of addition? Give an example of elimination.
(Elimination ko addition ka ulat kyun samjha jata hai? Elimination ki misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation:
Addition multiple bond khatam kar ke do reactants ko aik product banata hai; elimination substrate ke saath wale do atoms se atoms ya groups nikaal kar multiple bond banata hai.
CH₃CH₂Br + KOH (alcohol) → CH₂=CH₂ (ethene) + KBr + H₂O

book_ref.quote: Elimination reactions are regarded as reverse of addition reactions

blocks.prompt:
52 What is hydrolysis? Give an example.
(Hydrolysis kya hai? Misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation:
Hydrolysis mein compound paani se react kar ke do hisson mein toot jata hai, aksar H⁺ ya OH⁻ catalyst ki madad se.
CH₃COOCH₂CH₃ + H₂O →(H⁺) CH₃COOH + CH₃CH₂OH

book_ref.quote: a compound breaks into two on reaction with water often helped by

blocks.prompt:
53 Define condensation reaction. Give one example.
(Condensation reaction ki definition likhein. Aik misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation:
Do molecules mil kar bara molecule banate hain, chhota molecule (H₂O, NH₃, HCl) nikle ya na nikle.
CH₃COCH₃ + H₂N–OH → CH₃C(CH₃)=N–OH (propanone oxime) + H₂O

book_ref.quote: two molecules combine to form a bigger molecule with or without loss of a smaller molecule

blocks.prompt:
54 Differentiate between oxidation and reduction in organic compounds.
(Organic compounds mein oxidation aur reduction mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Muqabla:

book_ref.quote: Reduction is a reaction where gain of electron, loss of oxygen or gain of hydrogen

rows: C–O bonds ya carbon ki oxidation state barhna
C–O bonds ya carbon ki oxidation state kam hona

blocks.prompt:
55 State the basic statements used to understand organic reactions.
(Organic reactions samajhne ke liye bunyadi baatein likhein.)
blocks.explanation: (i) Covalent bond do tareeqon se toot-ta hai: homolytic aur heterolytic. (ii) Reagents teen qisam ke: free radicals, electrophiles aur nucleophiles. (iii) Organic reactions saat qisam ke: substitution, addition, elimination, hydrolysis, condensation, oxidation, reduction.

book_ref.quote: There are basically three types of reagents

blocks.prompt:
56 What is a reaction mechanism? Name its two main types.
(Reaction mechanism kya hai? Is ki do bari qismein batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Mechanism reaction ka woh raasta hai jo substrate mein bonds ka tootna aur banna dikhata hai. Reagents ke lehaz se yeh (i) free radical ya (ii) ionic (polar) mechanism hai.

book_ref.quote: A mechanism is the pathway adapted by a reaction showing the breaking and making of bonds

blocks.prompt:
57 Name the three steps of a free radical mechanism and state what happens in each.
(Free radical mechanism ke teen qadam aur har qadam mein kya hota hai, likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Initiation: shuru ke free radicals bante hain (homolysis). Propagation: yeh radicals mazeed radicals banate hain. Termination: aik jaise ya mukhtalif radicals mil jaate hain aur reaction ruk jata hai.

book_ref.quote: The reaction involves initiation where initial free radicals are produced

blocks.prompt:
58 What is a leaving group? Identify it in the reaction of OH⁻ with bromomethane.
(Leaving group kya hai? OH⁻ aur bromomethane ke reaction mein ise pehchanein.)
blocks.explanation:
Nucleophilic substitution mein nucleophile saturated electrophilic carbon par hamla kar ke doosre nucleophile ki jagah leta hai, jise leaving group kehte hain.
OH⁻ + CH₃Br → CH₃OH + Br⁻; Br⁻ leaving group hai.

book_ref.quote: a nucleophile attacks on a saturated electrophilic carbon and substitutes another nucleophile called leaving group

blocks.prompt:
59 Differentiate between nucleophilic substitution and nucleophilic addition.
(Nucleophilic substitution aur nucleophilic addition mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Muqabla:

book_ref.quote: a nucleophile attacks on electrophilic carbon of a carbonyl compound to give addition product

rows: Nucleophile saturated electrophilic carbon par hamla karta hai
Nucleophile carbonyl compound ke electrophilic carbon par hamla karta hai

blocks.prompt:
60 What is electrophilic addition? Give an example.
(Electrophilic addition kya hai? Misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation:
Electrophile electron se bharpoor (nucleophilic) jagah jaise C=C ya C≡C bond par hamla karta hai aur addition product banta hai.
CH₂=CH₂ + HBr → CH₃–CH₂Br (bromoethane)

book_ref.quote: an electrophile attacks on an electron rich position (nucleophilic) like carbon-carbon double or triple bond

blocks.prompt:
61 In the elimination of HBr from bromoethane by OH⁻, which carbon is δ+ and why?
(OH⁻ se bromoethane mein HBr ke elimination mein kaun sa carbon δ+ hai aur kyun?)
blocks.explanation: Bromine se juda CH₂ carbon δ+ hai kyun ke bromine carbon se zyada electronegative hai. OH⁻ saath wale carbon se H nikalta hai, Br⁻ nikal jata hai, aur ethene, paani aur Br⁻ bante hain.

book_ref.quote: bromine is more electronegative than carbon, so that carbon is +delta

blocks.prompt:
62 Define isomers. Give one pair of isomers from the chapter.
(Isomers ki definition likhein. Chapter se isomers ka aik jora dein.)
blocks.explanation: Do ya zyada compounds jin ka molecular formula aik magar atoms ki tarteeb aur properties mukhtalif hon, isomers hain. Misaal: ethanol (CH₃CH₂OH) aur methoxymethane (CH₃OCH₃), dono C₂H₆O.

book_ref.quote: Two or more than two compounds which have same molecular formulae but different arrangement of atoms

blocks.prompt:
63 Differentiate between dextrorotatory and levorotatory compounds.
(Dextrorotatory aur levorotatory compounds mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono optically active hain; farq PPL ko ghumane ki simt ka hai:

book_ref.quote: Optical activity of a compound is identified by using plane polarised light (PPL)

blocks.prompt:
64 What is a polarimeter? How does it show whether a compound is optically active?
(Polarimeter kya hai? Yeh kaise batata hai ke compound optically active hai?)
blocks.explanation: Polarimeter PPL (aik wavelength wali, aik plane mein chalne wali roshni) se optical activity pehchanta aur naapta hai. Compound ka solution PPL ke raaste mein rakha jata hai: agar PPL ghoom jaye to optically active, warna inactive.

book_ref.quote: A polarimeter is used to identify and measure quantitively the optical activity

blocks.prompt:
65 What is a chiral carbon? Mark the chiral carbon in butan-2-ol, CH₃–CH(OH)–CH₂–CH₃.
(Chiral carbon kya hai? Butan-2-ol (CH₃–CH(OH)–CH₂–CH₃) mein chiral carbon batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Chaar mukhtalif atoms ya groups wala carbon chiral carbon hai. Butan-2-ol mein C-2 chiral hai: is par CH₃, H, OH aur CH₂CH₃ chaar mukhtalif groups hain.

book_ref.quote: A carbon atom bearing four different atoms or group of atoms is called chiral carbon

blocks.prompt:
66 Differentiate between chiral and achiral molecules.
(Chiral aur achiral molecules mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Muqabla:

book_ref.quote: Molecules which are superimposable on their mirror images are achiral

rows: Apni mirror image par superimpose nahi hota
Apni mirror image par superimpose ho jata hai
Jaise plane of symmetry wala molecule, maslan meso tartaric acid

blocks.prompt:
67 Why is chirality also called handedness?
(Chirality ko handedness kyun kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: 'Chiral' Greek lafz 'cheir' (haath) se hai. Hamare daayein aur baayein haath non-superimposable mirror images hain, chiral molecules ki tarah; is liye chirality ko handedness kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: Hence, chirality is also called handedness

blocks.prompt:
68 In how many forms does lactic acid exist? Name them.
(Lactic acid kitni shaklon mein paya jata hai? Naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Lactic acid mein aik chiral carbon hai (CH₃, H, OH, COOH se juda). Yeh do optically active shaklon, (+) aur (–) lactic acid, aur aik optically inactive racemic mixture (±) mein paya jata hai.

book_ref.quote: bonded to four different groups, i.e, CH₃, H, OH and COOH

blocks.prompt:
69 Why is a racemic mixture optically inactive? How is it symbolised?
(Racemic mixture optically inactive kyun hai? Is ka symbol kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Racemic mixture mein 50% dextrorotatory aur 50% levorotatory enantiomers hote hain. Enantiomers PPL ko barabar magar mukhalif simt mein ghumate hain, is liye rotation khatam ho jati hai. Naam se pehle (±) likhte hain.

book_ref.quote: When 50% dextrorotatory and 50% levorotatory enantiomers are present

blocks.prompt:
70 A compound has two different chiral carbon atoms. What is the maximum number of its optical isomers? When is this number reduced?
(Aik compound mein do mukhtalif chiral carbon atoms hain. Is ke zyada se zyada kitne optical isomers hain? Yeh tadaad kab kam hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Zyada se zyada optical isomers = 2ⁿ = 2² = 4. Agar do ya zyada aik jaise chiral carbons hon to tadaad kam ho jati hai (jaise tartaric acid jis ka meso form hai).

book_ref.quote: is given by the formula 2ⁿ, where 'n' is the number of chiral carbon atoms

blocks.prompt:
71 What is meant by internal compensation in meso forms?
(Meso forms mein internal compensation se kya muraad hai?)
blocks.explanation: Meso form mein kam az kam do aik jaise chiral carbons aur aik plane of symmetry hota hai jo use do mirror-image hisson mein baant-ta hai. Dono hisse PPL ko mukhalif simt ghumate hain, is liye aik ki rotation doosra usi molecule ke andar khatam kar deta hai: internal compensation.

book_ref.quote: rotation of one half of molecule is internally compensated (cancelled) by the other half

blocks.prompt:
72 Differentiate between conformational isomers and cis-trans isomers.
(Conformational isomers aur cis-trans isomers mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Muqabla:

book_ref.quote: are called conformational isomers because they are interconvertable

rows: C–C single bond ke gird free rotation se
C=C double bond ke gird restricted rotation se
Aik doosre mein badalte hain; room temperature par alag nahi hote
Room temperature par nahi badalte (π bond todne ko 263 kJ/mol chahiye)
Jaise butane ki shaklein I aur II

blocks.prompt:
73 Why is rotation about a C=C double bond restricted?
(C=C double bond ke gird rotation kyun ruki hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: C=C mein aik σ bond (sp² orbitals ka seedha overlap) aur aik π bond (p orbitals ka mutawazi overlap) hai. π bond molecule ko jakar deta hai; free rotation ke liye π bond todna parega jis ke liye 263 kJ/mol chahiye, jo room temperature par nahi milti.

book_ref.quote: It requires energy equal to 263 kJ/mol, which is not possible at room temperature

blocks.prompt:
74 Differentiate between cis and trans isomers.
(Cis aur trans isomers mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Muqabla:

book_ref.quote: The cis isomer is one in which two similar groups are on the same side of the double bond

rows: Do aik jaise groups double bond ki aik hi taraf
Do aik jaise groups double bond ki mukhalif taraf

blocks.prompt:
75 But-1-ene does not show cis-trans isomerism. Give reason.
(But-1-ene cis-trans isomerism nahi dikhata. Wajah batayein.)
blocks.explanation: H₂C=CH–CH₂–CH₃ mein double bond ke carbon 1 par do aik jaise groups (do H) hain. Cis-trans isomerism ke liye har double bond carbon par do mukhtalif groups chahiye, is liye but-1-ene yeh nahi dikhata.

book_ref.quote: Each of the above two compounds does not show cis-trans isomerism

blocks.prompt:
76 Name any four physical properties in which cis and trans isomers differ.
(Woh chaar physical properties likhein jin mein cis aur trans isomers mukhtalif hain.)
blocks.explanation: Melting point, boiling point, dipole moment, density (aur heat of vapourisation). Trans isomer cis se zyada stable hai, is liye chemical reactivity bhi mukhtalif hai.

book_ref.quote: The trans isomers are more stable than the corresponding cis isomers

blocks.prompt:
77 Why is chirality important in drug development?
(Dawaiyan banane mein chirality kyun aham hai?)
blocks.explanation: Biological systems chiral building blocks se bane hain; drug receptors khaas 'chiral locks' ki tarah hain. Is liye chiral dawa ke do enantiomers ka asar bohat mukhtalif hota hai, aur chirality dawa ki safety aur efficacy tay karti hai.

book_ref.quote: the two enantiomers of a chiral drug often exhibit vastly different potentials and profiles

blocks.prompt:
78 What did research show about the two isomers of thalidomide?
(Thalidomide ke do isomers ke baare mein research se kya pata chala?)
blocks.explanation: (+) isomer asar dar aur mehfooz tranquilliser tha, jabke (–) isomer fetus (pet ke bachche) ko nuqsan deta tha. Khalis (+) isomer bhi khoon mein jaldi racemise ho jata hai (10 minute mein 50% se zyada), is liye sirf (+) isomer dena masla hal nahi karta.

book_ref.quote: the (+) isomer was an effective and safe tranquilliser, the (-) isomer was the culprit

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Racemisation ka matlab hai khalis (+) isomer ka (+) aur (–) ke 50 : 50 mixture mein badal jana. Is liye khalis (+) thalidomide dene ke baad bhi khoon mein (–) isomer ban jata hai.
